messages:
olivia_prod: Quick sync — prepping the on‑prem + VPC rollout checklist for next quarter. Need alignment on upgrade paths, customer‑managed networking, packaging, and minimum SLA language for Private customers. Posting a draft checklist below; please flag must‑haves or blockers by EOD.

olivia_prod: ```yaml
checklist:
  packaging: [helm-chart, installer-tarball, airgap-image]
  upgrade_modes: [auto-if-egress, manual-airgap]
  kms: [hsm-integration, offline-key-import]
  runbooks: [preflight, rollback, post-upgrade-validation]
  beta_criteria: [5-customers, docs-complete, 2-staging-upgrades]
```

leila_eng: quick q — are we locking to k8s >=1.25? we saw 1.22 in a customer cluster last week. :eyes:

devon_se: field note: customers consistently ask for PKI rotation as a first-class operation and a minimal inbound port list. upgrade windows: they want <2h maintenance where possible.

matt_sre: Heads up on SLA wording: we can guarantee 99.9 for Redwood Dedicated. For Private (onprem) we need to be explicit — propose we offer a "platform-supported" SLA of 99.5 with strict caveat that network, infra, and power are customer's responsibility. Also need rollback time budgets in runbooks.

nina_security: Important: KMS/HSM integration path must be documented end-to-end. For air‑gapped installs we need an offline key import flow and guidance for HSM attestation. Add NAC/SAML/SCIM testing matrix to docs.

sam_cs: From CS: finance teams require token-level billing visibility + per-route usage telemetry. Also they'll want a migration FAQ for onprem -> dedicated.

devon_se: Also note: our upcoming agent v4 supports zero-touch upgrades when outbound egress is allowed. For airgapped customers we must surface a conservative manual upgrade path and verification checks.

leila_eng: Packaging plan: we ship two artifacts — a Helm chart (for k8s-managed installs) and an installer tarball (for airgap/ops teams). Docs must call out `--no-auto-upgrade` and how to pin runtimes/quantization profiles.

olivia_prod: Agree. Proposal for release gates: (a) 5 beta customers onboarded, (b) docs + runbooks complete, (c) 2 successful staging-to-staging private upgrades. Candidate SLOs to validate in beta: median tail latency, successful upgrade rate > 95%. Thoughts on fallback?

matt_sre: Fallback to hosted only if customer explicitly allows egress/fallback in their contract. For fully offline private, fallback isn't possible — call that out in comms. We should add automated preflight checks (kernel modules, port availability, cgroup versions) that fail early.

devon_se: I'll draft a compact upgrade matrix to include in the docs:
```
mode: onprem-airgap -> upgrade: manual (operator-driven)
mode: vpc-managed -> upgrade: automated (rolling)
mode: dedicated -> upgrade: rolling (Redwood-managed)
```

nina_security: Add to checklist: ensure KMS keys never leave the appliance logs, add key-store-audit step in post-upgrade validation, and list required approvals for HSM. One Q — do we require an external PCI/third-party audit for HSM installs? I'll check.

olivia_prod: OK. Action items: @devon_se own the upgrade-path doc; @leila_eng produce packaging artifact list and `--no-auto-upgrade` UX copy; @nina_security write KMS/HSM + offline import steps; @sam_cs prep migration FAQ and customer comm templates.

devon_se: I'll take upgrade-path doc. ETA Wed EOD.

leila_eng: I'll publish packaging artifact list tomorrow morning.

nina_security: I'll add KMS/HSM and offline import steps. Confirming whether HSM triggers extra audit hoops — will report.

sam_cs: I'll draft the migration FAQ + communication templates and share with product for review.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging cluster at 2027-02-10 03:00 UTC — private-deploy/v0.9.8

olivia_prod: :thumbsup: thanks all. If no blockers by EOD I'll fold this checklist into the roadmap doc and mark the initiative "beta-ready" for Friday.
